items.title: Constraint Decay: The Fragility of LLM Agents in Back End Code Generation
items.raw_content:
Hacker News score: 287 points, 197 comments | linked site: arxiv.org | submitted by wek

Article description: Large Language Model (LLM) agents demonstrate strong performance in autonomous code generation under loose specifications. However, production-grade software requires strict adherence to structural constraints, such as architectural patterns, databases, and object-relational mappings. Existing benchmarks often overlook these non-functional requirements, rewarding functionally correct but structurally arbitrary solutions. We present a systematic study evaluating how well agents handle structural constraints in multi-file backend generation. By fixing a unified API contract across 80 greenfield
items.title_zh: 约束衰减：LLM 智能体在后端代码生成中的脆弱性
items.summary: arXiv paper studying how well LLM agents honor structural constraints in multi-file backend generation, fixing one API contract across 80 greenfield projects; 287 points and 197 comments on Hacker News.
